briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate frontier race with multimodal breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies as multiple labs release frontier models with enhanced reasoning. Compute buildouts accelerate globally while regulatory scrutiny grows. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation gains traction in security discussions.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with advanced agentic capabilities; xAI releases Grok-4; DeepSeek-V3 achieves competitive benchmarks. Meta's Llama 4.1 open weights update sparks developer adoption.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New EU AI Act enforcement begins targeting high-risk deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell GPUs at scale; Microsoft announces $5B data center expansion in Texas. TSMC reports record AI chip orders for Q4.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese consortium by 2028?
